trap.label: dedução presente × passado
trap.wrong: She must be at lunch yesterday.
trap.right: She must have been at lunch yesterday.
trap.why: Em português “deve estar” e “deve ter estado” são formas distintas, mas o brasileiro mantém “must be” para o passado. Em inglês, passado = modal + have + particípio.

fix.right: They must have been late yesterday.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “She must be at lunch.”
rewrite.answer: She must have been at lunch.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “He can’t be angry.”
Passe para o passado: “They might be late.”
